'''2007 Worlds Day 2 J.W. Miller DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[J.W. Miller]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title Beedo Ops. Dual Imperial Decree (printed + (V)). Visage → [[Visage Of The Emperor]]. Tractor Beam×2 listed as shields.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[J.W. Miller]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
